assay_run.method: Paired-end sequencing of total RNA using P3 XLEAP 200-cycle chemistry. Native library label: Sample 1. Sequencing-library pooling is reported; multiplex membership and physical run identifiers are not supplied. The article reports RNA isolation with the Zymo Research Quick-RNA Microprep Kit. The matching GEO sample extract protocol reports the Qiagen RNeasy Mini Kit. The extraction kit for this library remains unresolved.
